gaps: ZIG.GAP.1: `opaque {}` types parse cleanly but emit no symbol. Zig models runtime interfaces via opaque types + function pointers (no class inheritance), so there are no fields/extends to surface; the type is intentionally not indexed.

ZIG.GAP.2: `test "name" {}` blocks emit no function symbol (anonymous, unstable scope). Calls and field-uses inside a test body are still captured with source '(global)', so the code-intel graph does not lose them.
